title: H0019 (2022 Regular): Firearm Restrictions Pursuant to Court Findings or Risk Protection Orders

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2021-08-02; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2022/19/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2429125))
provenance.note: As-filed text (filed 2021-08-02); no votes recorded. Subparagraph 1 of the penalty (felony) is existing law, renumbered.

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.065(2)(a)4.c.(II), F.S.): The department must enter the record into the National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database of persons who are prohibited from purchasing a firearm. If a judge or magistrate orders the submittal of the record to the department, the record must be submitted to the department and entered into the NCIC within 24 hours.
Section 2 (s. 790.401(11)(b)1., F.S.): A person who has in his or her custody or control a firearm or any ammunition or who purchases, possesses, or receives a firearm or any ammunition with knowledge that he or she is prohibited from doing so by an order issued under this section commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.
Section 2 (s. 790.401(11)(b)2., F.S.): A person who attempts to commit a violation of subparagraph 1. commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.
